title: Pipeline Puzzle
summary: Transform noisy data with pipes and command-line tools.
description: This dataset contains duplicates and irrelevant lines. Use standard input/output, pipes, sorting and unique filtering to write a clean three-line `normalized.txt` file. The validator checks the content, not your shell history.

workspace_seed.events.txt:
INFO: boot complete
ALERT: login_failure
DEBUG: cache warm
ALERT: config_changed
ALERT: login_failure
INFO: status green
ALERT: service_restarted
ALERT: service_restarted

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: Think of each command as a small tool whose output can become another tool’s input.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Inspect `events.txt`, filter lines beginning with `ALERT`, then sort them and remove duplicates.

offline_hints.title: Guided route
offline_hints.content: Create `normalized.txt` containing exactly `ALERT: config_changed`, `ALERT: login_failure`, and `ALERT: service_restarted` in sorted order, one per line. A pipeline using `grep`, `sort`, and `uniq` is one route.

validation.content:
ALERT: config_changed
ALERT: login_failure
ALERT: service_restarted

completion_explanation: You completed Pipeline Puzzle. Review the evidence, compare the observed result with the expected state, and explain why it matters in a real defensive workflow.

network_requirements.description: No network interface is required for this mission.
